name: Politecnico di Bari
research_summary: Politecnico di Bari's official 2026/27 Computer Engineering MSc is Class LM-32, two years/120 ECTS and taught in English, with curricula in AI and Data Science, Cybersecurity and Cloud, and Cyberphysical Systems. Applicants needed a suitable bachelor's degree, at least 48 ECTS across listed engineering, computer-science, mathematics and related areas, adequate individual preparation and English B2; any curricular integrations had to be completed before entry. The mandatory Esse3 application had multiple 2026/27 windows and had to precede the later enrollment period. Foreign qualifications required document and authenticity checks; applicants needing a visa also used Universitaly. The 2026/27 tuition contribution varied by ISEE and merit/study-progress eligibility: the fee regulation sets no-tax-area criteria and a €2,257.60 contribution cap for high or absent eligible ISEE, plus regional tax and stamp duty. ADISU Puglia aid was an annual competitive call, while the Poliba international award reviewed was restricted to one already-admitted Palestinian student resident in Gaza. No new 2027/28 Computer Engineering first-year call or terms were found; the published February 2027 notice concerns first-level courses only.
